title: Your WoltFlow Inbox
description: Every WoltFlow user receives a personalized email address for receiving gift card codes and automation-related emails. Your inbox is completely private, secure, and managed exclusively for your automation needs.

personalEmailAddress.title: Your Personal Email Address
personalEmailAddress.description: When you set up WoltFlow, you automatically receive a unique email address in this format:
personalEmailAddress.note: This address is exclusively yours and cannot be mixed with other users' emails.

emailReception.title: Email Reception
emailReception.description: Your WoltFlow inbox is kept for 30 days and only saves WoltFlow gift card emails based on the filter you set in your email forwarding.
emailContent: Filtered based on your forwarding settings

automaticProcessing.title: Automatic Processing
automaticProcessing.description: The system automatically processes incoming emails to extract relevant information.

steps.title: Email Arrival
steps.description: Emails arrive at your personalized WoltFlow inbox address through forwarding or direct sending

steps.title: Email Storage
steps.description: Emails are kept securely in your inbox based on the filter criteria you set up

steps.title: Code Extraction During Automation
steps.description: When the automation runs, it extracts the gift card code from the email received today that matches the correct subject and sender

steps.title: Display in Inbox
steps.description: Processed emails appear in your WoltFlow inbox interface for review and management

managingEmails.title: Managing Your Emails
managingEmails.description: Your WoltFlow inbox provides a clean, organized interface for viewing and managing all emails received by your automation system. Access your inbox anytime to review email history and download attachments.

inboxFeatures.title: Inbox Features
features: Clean, organized email interface similar to Gmail
Full email content display with HTML rendering
Responsive design for mobile and desktop

searchFilter.title: Search & Filter
features: Search emails by sender, subject, or content
Date range filtering for historical emails
Quick access to recent and important emails

secureDownloads.title: Secure Attachment Downloads
secureDownloads.description: Emails with attachments (PDFs, images, documents) can be downloaded securely through your WoltFlow inbox. We handle almost all attachment types (.pdf, .png, .jpg, .doc, etc.). Downloads are secure because only authorized users can access them from our servers.

attachmentTypes.title: Gift Card PDFs
attachmentTypes.description: Download PDF gift card confirmations with embedded codes and terms

attachmentTypes.title: Visual Confirmations
attachmentTypes.description: Download images containing QR codes or visual gift card representations

dataIsolation.title: Data Isolation
dataIsolation.description: Your inbox is completely isolated from other users' data with multiple security layers.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.description: We maintain strict privacy standards for all email content and attachments.
commitments: No data sharing with third parties

policies.title: Extracted Codes
policies.description: Gift card codes for automation use

dataControl.title: Your Data, Your Control
dataControl.description: You have complete control over your inbox data. You can delete individual emails, clear your entire inbox, or delete your account (which removes all associated data) at any time.

readyToUse.title: Ready to Use Your Inbox?
readyToUse.description: Your personalized WoltFlow inbox is ready to receive and process emails for your automation.
